ei.title: 천문학의 별과 영화/스포츠 스타의 유사한 특징
ei.subject: ReadingPower유형편완성

fullPassage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, produce their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. So it is, metaphorically, with the stars of motion pictures and team sports. They attract attention by themselves. People will pay to attend movies or games in which they appear because they are appearing. When Michael Jordan, the dominant basketball player of the last decade of the twentieth century, entered his second retirement from the sport, the team for which he played, the Washington Wizards, attracted sellout audiences everywhere it played. The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended the team's games. This pattern resumed after he retired again.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones ①<u>visible</u> in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, ②<u>produce</u> their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, ③<u>relied</u> on other bodies for ④<u>illumination</u> and warmth. So it is, metaphorically, with the stars of motion pictures and team sports. They attract attention by themselves. People will pay to attend movies or games in which they appear because they are appearing. When Michael Jordan, the dominant basketball player of the last decade of the twentieth century, entered his second retirement from the sport, the team for which he played, the Washington Wizards, attracted sellout audiences everywhere it played. The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended the team's games. This pattern resumed after he retired again.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ relied → relying: rather than 뒤에 동명사 relying이 와야 함. relied(과거형)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① visible: 형용사 보어 — 원문 일치
✅ ② produce: 주어 stars 복수 + 동사원형 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ relied → relying (rather than + 동명사. relied는 과거형으로 병렬 불가)
✅ ④ illumination: 전치사 for의 목적어 명사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: rather than + 동명사(-ing): 앞의 produce와 대조되는 동작을 나타낼 때 동명사 사용.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, produce their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. So it is, ①<u>metaphorical</u>, with the stars of motion pictures and team sports. They ②<u>attract</u> attention by themselves. People will pay to ③<u>attend</u> movies or games in which they appear because they are ④<u>appearing</u>. When Michael Jordan, the dominant basketball player of the last decade of the twentieth century, entered his second retirement from the sport, the team for which he played, the Washington Wizards, attracted sellout audiences everywhere it played. The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended the team's games. This pattern resumed after he retired again.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① metaphorical → metaphorically: So it is 사이에 삽입된 부사. 동사 is를 수식하므로 부사 metaphorically가 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① metaphorical → metaphorically (동사 is를 수식하는 부사 필요. 형용사 metaphorical은 불가)
✅ ② attract: 주어 They 복수 + 동사원형 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ attend: will pay to attend — to부정사 내 동사원형 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ appearing: because they are appearing — 현재진행 — 원문 일치
det.tip: So it is, metaphorically: 삽입 부사. 동사를 수식하므로 -ly 부사형.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, produce their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. When Michael Jordan, the dominant basketball player of the last decade of the twentieth century, ①<u>entered</u> his second retirement from the sport, the team for which he ②<u>played</u>, the Washington Wizards, ③<u>attracted</u> sellout audiences ④<u>wherever</u> it played. The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended the team's games. This pattern resumed after he retired again.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ wherever → everywhere: 원문은 everywhere it played(부사). wherever은 접속사로 다른 구문을 요구.
det.analysis:
✅ ① entered: 주어 Michael Jordan + 과거동사 — 원문 일치
✅ ② played: the team for which he played — 관계절 과거동사 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ attracted: the Washington Wizards attracted — 과거동사 — 원문 일치
❌ ④ wherever → everywhere (원문 everywhere는 부사. wherever은 양보/조건 접속사로 구문이 달라짐)
det.tip: everywhere it played: '그 팀이 경기하는 곳마다'의 부사적 표현. wherever은 접속부사절을 이끌어 문맥상 다른 구문.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② which → for which: 원문은 the team for which he played(전치사+관계대명사). played는 자동사로 전치사 for가 필요. which만 쓰면 전치사 누락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① in which: games in which they appear — 전치사+관계대명사 — 원문 일치
❌ ② which → for which (play for the team → the team for which he played. 전치사 for 누락)
✅ ③ far fewer: 비교급 강조 부사 far + fewer — 원문 일치
✅ ④ had attended: 대과거 — the previous year 기준 과거완료 — 원문 일치
det.tip: play for a team: 전치사 for가 필수. 관계절로 바꾸면 the team for which he played.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, ①<u>produce</u> their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ indifference → attention: '그들은 스스로 관심(attention)을 끈다'는 맥락. indifference(무관심)는 정반대 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① produce: 별이 빛과 열을 생산한다 — 원문 일치
✅ ② metaphorically: 은유적으로 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ indifference → attention (스타는 관심을 끈다. indifference는 반대)
✅ ④ dominant: 지배적인 농구 선수 — 원문 일치
det.tip: attract attention: 관심을 끌다. indifference(무관심)는 의미가 정반대.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, produce their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① empty → sellout: 조던이 뛰자 매진(sellout) 관중을 끌어들였다는 맥락. empty(빈)는 정반대 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① empty → sellout (조던 합류 후 매진 관중. empty는 반대)
✅ ② fewer: 조던 부재 시 더 적은 관중 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ attended: 관중이 경기에 참석했다 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ resumed: 패턴이 재개되었다 — 원문 일치
det.tip: attracted sellout audiences: 매진 관중을 끌어들이다. empty(빈)는 정반대.

questions.stem: 천문학적 별은 다른 천체에 의존하지 않고 스스로 빛과 열을 만들어낸다.

det.korean: S1: produce their own light and heat rather than ... relying on other bodies → 다른 천체에 의존하지 않고 자체적으로 빛과 열 생산 → 진술 일치 → T
det.analysis:
✅ T: S1에서 별이 스스로 빛과 열을 생산하며 다른 천체에 의존하지 않는다고 명시 — 일치
❌ F: 오답
det.tip: S1: produce their own light and heat — 자체 발광·발열.

questions.stem: 마이클 조던이 워싱턴 위저즈에서 활약하기 전 해에도 이 팀은 매 경기 좌석이 매진되었다.

det.korean: S6: The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended → 조던 부재 시 관중이 훨씬 적었음 → 매진이 아님 → F
det.analysis:
❌ T: S6에서 far fewer spectators — 매진과 반대
✅ F: 조던 부재 시 관중 감소. 매진 진술과 충돌
det.tip: S6: far fewer spectators — '훨씬 적은' 관중으로 매진 아님.

questions.stem: 조던의 재은퇴 이후에도 워싱턴 위저즈의 관중 매진 현상은 계속 이어졌다.

det.korean: S7: This pattern resumed after he retired again → this pattern = 조던 부재 시 관중 감소 패턴(S6). 매진이 아닌 관중 감소가 재개됨 → F
det.analysis:
❌ T: This pattern은 S6의 관중 감소를 가리킴. 매진 지속과 반대
✅ F: 재은퇴 후 관중 감소 패턴이 재개됨
det.tip: S7: This pattern = far fewer spectators (S6). resumed = 관중 감소가 다시 시작.

det.korean: S2: '영화와 단체 스포츠의 스타도 은유적으로 그러하다'라는 맥락에서 빈칸은 motion pictures and team sports.
det.analysis:
✅ ① motion pictures and team sports: S2에서 천문학적 별과 비유되는 대상 — 문맥 일치
❌ ② astronomical research and exploration: 천문학 연구는 별 자체이지 비유 대상 아님
❌ ③ science fiction and fantasy literature: 본문에 문학 언급 없음
❌ ④ political campaigns and public speeches: 본문에 정치 언급 없음
det.tip: S2: with the stars of ____: 별의 은유적 대상 = 영화와 팀 스포츠.

det.korean: S5: 조던이 뛰자 워싱턴 위저즈가 매 원정 경기에서 매진 관중을 끌어들였다는 맥락. attracted sellout audiences가 적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① produced their own light and heat for the spectators: S1의 별 표현. 팀에 대한 서술로 부적절
✅ ② attracted sellout audiences everywhere it played: S5 조던 합류 후 매진 관중 — 문맥 일치
❌ ③ entered his second retirement from the sport: S5 후반의 내용이지만 빈칸 자리와 맞지 않음
❌ ④ resumed the pattern of the previous year: S7 내용이지만 빈칸 자리의 주어/맥락과 불일치
det.tip: S5~S6 대비: 조던 합류 시 매진(sellout) vs 부재 시 far fewer. 빈칸은 합류 효과.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ S4: People will pay to attend movies or games in which they appear because they are appearing → 출연 자체가 이유 → 일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① S1 반대: as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies — 지구는 다른 천체에 의존

✅ ④ S4: 스타가 출연하기 때문에(because they are appearing) 돈을 지불 — 일치
det.tip: S4: because they are appearing — 출연 자체가 관객의 지불 이유.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ S5: entered his second retirement from the sport — '두 번째 은퇴'이므로 위저즈에서 처음 은퇴한 것이 아님. 일치하지 않음.
det.analysis:

✅ ② S2: So it is, metaphorically, with the stars of motion pictures and team sports — 일치
❌ ③ S5: his second retirement — 두 번째 은퇴. '처음으로 은퇴'와 불일치
✅ ④ S6: far fewer spectators had attended — 일치
det.tip: S5: his second retirement — 두 번째 은퇴. 위저즈에서 '첫' 은퇴가 아니라 '두 번째' 은퇴.

det.korean: ① scattering → scattered: the ones (which are) scattered — 과거분사 수식. 별이 흩어진 상태(수동)이므로 scattered가 맞음. scattering(능동/현재분사)은 부적절.

✅ ② by themselves: 스스로 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ the dominant: 한정사+형용사+명사 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ far fewer: 비교급 강조 far + fewer — 원문 일치
det.tip: scattered: 별이 우주에 흩어'져 있는' 수동 상태 → 과거분사. scattering은 능동.

questions.passage: Astronomical stars, the ones visible in the sky at night or scattered across the universe, produce their own light and heat rather than, as with the planet Earth, relying on other bodies for illumination and warmth. So it is, metaphorically, with the stars of motion pictures and team sports. They attract attention by themselves. People will pay to attend movies or games in which they appear because they are appearing. When Michael Jordan, the dominant basketball player of the last decade of the twentieth century, entered his second retirement from the sport, the team for which he played, the Washington Wizards, attracted sellout audiences everywhere it played. The previous year, when Jordan was not playing for the Wizards, far fewer spectators had attended the team's games. This pattern resumed after he retired again.

det.analysis: S3: They attract attention by themselves → 4단어: attract(1) attention(2) by(3) themselves(4)
det.tip: S3: attract attention by themselves — 스스로 관심을 끄는 능력.
